full_judgment: 4. The defendants have been contesting the suit by filing a Joint written statement praying for dismissal of the suit. The plaintiffs examined 3 PWs and the contesting defendants examined 5 DWs The learned Senior Assistant Judge, Additional Court, Mymensingh by the judgment and decree dated 17-10-1993 dismissed the suit. The plaintiff then preferred Other Crass Appeal No. 8 of 1994 before the learned District Judge, Mymensingh. The appeal was transferred to the Court of the learned Joint District Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Mymensingh for disposal and the said learned Judge by judgment and order dated 11-11-2002 allowed the appeal and sent back the suit on remand. Thereafter, the learned Assistant Judge took thumb impression of the executant of the deed in question in the absence of the defendant on 29-9-2004 and sent the same for expert opinion and the Finger Print Expert submitted his report on 2-3-2006. The contesting defendants filed written objection against the said report. The trial Court examined the aforesaid Finger Print Expert as DW 6. The trial Court then by the impugned order dated 12-4-2006 directed that final decision with regard to Thumb Impression Expert Report shall be considered at the time of delivery of judgment and a date was fixed for hearing arguments.
